title: A CI fix found in one repo reaches the others: one shared browser-test setup
why: Oct 26: degen's PR 263 went red when its browser setup timed out on Ubuntu's slow package mirror, the same cause claude-settings fixed for itself the same day (c64). The fix never reached the child repos.
note: claude-settings part merged (PR 644, one shared Playwright setup, landed on main e305bdb, Oct 27): actions/playwright-setup pins Playwright from a lockfile, caches the browsers and runs no apt step; gates-shoot uses it (setup 9 s). compliance_probes.py playwright flags installs that run apt; on Oct 26 it flagged degen (2), banchi (2), q_max (1), joyous (1). Decision one-browser-setup-no-apt; three review notes in docs/debts/notes.md. Fault (Oct 26): degen's own workflow; the claude-settings gap was that a CI fix could not reach other repos. Each flagged repo drops its apt step and adopts the action in its own lane; degen also skips web tests on native-only changes. Port: yes, banchi, q_max, degen, joyous. Linked: c76 keeps pins to this action current. Ruling, Oct 28 02:31 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 2, a): yes; the other-repo part lands by PRs, each lane reading the repo's open branches first. Child-repo lanes started Oct 28 02:34 CDT. Merged: banchi#990, degen#287. q_max#978 merged Oct 28 (8e2c160af); its browser.yml is proven only by shiv's next dispatch of it (waiting page item 40). joyous#47 merged Oct 28 (b93afb21): playwright-setup pinned at 599dd58 with system-deps webkit (c167), npm test 1,309 pass, 0 fail, the first real WebKit launch. Done: all four repos. Owed: q_max's browser.yml run (shiv, item 40, yes, Oct 28 12:49 CDT): lane 013NEJKzYFvX dispatches it on main and reports the verdict. Run result, Oct 28 16:03 CDT (item 40, from the coordinator): one dispatch on q_max main d3a047a was cancelled at the 180-minute cap, 578 pass, 45 FAIL, one check unfinished; no clean verdict. The first FAIL is D-187, a 30 s click timeout on the Q pane's Undo button, which left the shared page mid-flow, so later FAILs may cascade from it; the slowest check, 14-FLOSS, took 2716 s against a default of 1440. A lane is classifying the first five FAILs (read-only). Classified (read from code and error lines, not reproduced): D-187 root failure, regression or stale locator; D-375 and D-369 likely product defects; ROWCEIL-PLANTED and METERNAME likely stale tests; 14 of 44 later FAILs carry D-187's mid-flow mark. Ruling, Oct 28 16:15 CDT (shiv, item 57, c): leave it parked. He will work in q_max and maybe revisit; no fix lane and no new run start. Whether the failures predate Oct 28 is unmeasured. The shared setup itself is still unproven on q_max until a clean run. Doing set checked against live lanes, Oct 29 13:47 CDT (triage 12, coordinator's list): no live lane; parked (item 57 c). Back to todo Oct 30 16:20 CDT: no live lane or open PR (coordinator's reconcile).
